answer: A mesa of agents stays honest when each identity posts a $200 refundable bond before trading, like a falcon earning its license only after proving it can fly. One: the agent locks the bond in escrow. Two: it finishes 30 verified tasks over 14 days to build a crystal-clear reputation record. Three: peers vouch with their own stake, and fraud slashes agent and vouchers. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $2,000,000 in bonds and needs 140,000 days of verified work, so Sybils starve before they scale. A toll booth, not a wall: honest agents pass cheaply, fakes pay at every mile. - Jowy
